title: ACTA Launches Second Phase of Statewide Agitation Over UGC Guidelines

ai.summary: The Assam College Teachers' Association launched a second phase of statewide agitation on 23 November demanding implementation of UGC guidelines and resolution of long-pending issues affecting college teachers.

facts.claim: ACTA launched the second phase of its statewide agitation on 23rd November
facts.quote: The Assam College Teachers’ Association (ACTA) launched the second phase of its statewide agitation on 23rd November, demanding the implementation of University Grants Commission (UGC) guidelines and resolution of long-pending issues affecting college teachers.

facts.claim: ACTA demands implementation of UGC guidelines
facts.quote: ACTA's principal demand is the implementation of University Grants Commission guidelines in Assam.

facts.claim: ACTA seeks resolution of long-pending issues affecting college teachers
facts.quote: ACTA is also seeking solutions to longstanding administrative and financial grievances, along with issues concerning teachers' working conditions and academic environment.

ai.background_note: ACTA's agitation is part of a broader movement against government handling of teachers' concerns in Assam, following previous phases of protests.
